# opnsense_interfaces_assignment (Data Source)

Assigns a physical (or virtual) device to a logical interface, such as `wan`, `lan`, or an optional `optN` interface.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Logical interface identifier (e.g. `wan`, `lan`, `opt1`).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `device` (String) The physical (or virtual) device assigned to this interface.
- `lock` (Boolean) Whether removal of the interface is prevented.
